Bioregulators

Khavinson Peptide Bioregulators — United States

Bioregulators are di-, tri- and tetrapeptides: the shortest compounds in the catalog, and the easiest to identify, because a four-residue sequence leaves a laboratory little room for ambiguity. The family comes from Vladimir Khavinson's group at the St Petersburg Institute of Bioregulation and Gerontology, where each was derived from a peptide fraction of one organ or tissue and named for it — Epitalon (AEDG) for the pineal gland, Cartalax (AEDL) for cartilage, Vesugen (KED) for vascular tissue, Pinealon (EDR) for cortex, Thymogen (EW) for thymus.

Telling them apart is a matter of sequence, and the sequence is on every page with the CAS number and formula. N-Acetyl Epitalon is a separate compound, not a brand of epitalon. Cerebrolysin and thymulin are longer and sit here because they are studied in the same tradition.

The English-language literature on this family is thinner than the Russian-language original, and the product pages do not pretend otherwise. What is not thin is the certificate: purity and measured content for every lot, against the batch code on the vial. Supplied strictly for laboratory research, shipped domestically within the United States.

What to check before buying bioregulators compounds

Purity is half the number. A purity figure tells you what fraction of the powder in the vial is the compound on the label — it tells you nothing about how much powder is in the vial. A lot can assay at 99.8% purity and still be short against its labelled content.

Both numbers are published for every batch here: purity from HPLC, and measured mass against expected content. Match the batch code printed on the vial to the certificate before you rely on either.

records.title: AHK-cu
records.description:
AHK-Cu is a synthetic tripeptide — Ala-His-Lys — bound to a copper(II) ion, produced for controlled laboratory research into follicular and dermal signaling. The histidine and lysine residues form the copper-binding site, and the complex is studied as a vehicle for delivering copper to cells in a bound rather than free ionic form.
In scientific literature, AHK-Cu is studied for its effect on isolated human hair follicles in culture. The broader copper-tripeptide class, chiefly GHK-Cu, is studied for interaction with fibroblast collagen synthesis, matrix metalloproteinase expression, keratinocyte integrin signaling, and tissue remodeling gene expression in controlled in vitro and preclinical models.

records.title: Goralatide (Ac-SDKP)
records.description:
Goralatide is a synthetic tetrapeptide — N-acetyl-Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro — produced for controlled laboratory research into fibrotic and haematopoietic signaling. It corresponds to the N-terminal four residues of thymosin β4 (Tβ4), the 43-amino-acid actin-sequestering protein sold in research markets under the name TB-500.
In scientific literature, Ac-SDKP is studied as an endogenous regulatory peptide released from thymosin β4 by prolyl oligopeptidase and meprin-α, and cleared from circulation by the N-domain of angiotensin-converting enzyme. Research frameworks examine its role in collagen synthesis, fibroblast proliferation, inflammatory cell recruitment, and haematopoietic progenitor cell cycling within controlled in vitro and preclinical models.

KPV is a synthetic tripeptide composed of lysine–proline–valine and is derived from the C-terminal fragment of alpha-melanocyte–stimulating hormone (α-MSH). It is developed for controlled laboratory research involving peptide-mediated signaling systems.

records.title: SLU-PP-332 Capsules

variants.title: 250mcg per capsule / Single Bottle - Pack of 60

records.shortDescription:
PPARδ Agonist Research Compound
SLU-PP-332 is a small-molecule research compound studied as a selective peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta (PPARδ) agonist. It is developed for controlled laboratory investigation involving nuclear receptor signaling systems.

records.title: Cardiogen
records.shortDescription:
Peptide Bioregulator
Cardiogen is a short synthetic peptide of the bioregulator class, studied in research for tissue-specific activity in myocardial-tissue models.

records.title: 5-Amino-1MQ Capsules

variants.title: 50mg per capsule / Single Bottle - Pack of 60

records.shortDescription:
Nicotinamide N-Methyltransferase (NNMT) Inhibitor Research Compound — Capsules
5-Amino-1MQ is a small-molecule research compound studied as an inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT), an enzyme involved in cellular metabolic regulation. It is developed for controlled laboratory investigation within experimental environments.

records.title: Orforglipron Capsules

variants.title: 6mg per capsule / Single Bottle - Pack of 60

records.shortDescription:
Oral GLP-1 Receptor Agonist
Orforglipron is a synthetic, non-peptide small molecule studied in research as an orally available agonist of the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor.

records.title: Dihexa Capsules

variants.title: 10mg per capsule / Single Bottle - Pack of 60

records.shortDescription:
Angiotensin IV Analogue — Capsules
Dihexa is a synthetic angiotensin IV–derived peptidomimetic studied in research for procognitive and synaptogenic activity.

records.title: ARA-290
records.shortDescription:
Non-Erythropoietic EPO Analogue
ARA-290 (cibinetide) is a synthetic 11–amino acid peptide engineered from the structure of erythropoietin, studied in research for tissue-protective signaling without erythropoietic activity.

records.title: Thymulin
records.shortDescription:
Zinc-Dependent Thymic Peptide
Thymulin is a zinc-dependent nonapeptide hormone of thymic origin, studied in research for immunoregulatory signaling.

records.title: Cerebrolysin
records.shortDescription:
Neuropeptide Preparation
Cerebrolysin is a peptide preparation derived from porcine brain tissue, studied in research for neurotrophic and neuroprotective signaling.

records.title: LL-37
records.shortDescription:
Cathelicidin Antimicrobial Peptide
LL-37 is the active fragment of the human cathelicidin antimicrobial peptide, studied in research for antimicrobial and immunomodulatory activity.

records.title: Chonluten
records.shortDescription:
Peptide Bioregulator
Chonluten is a short synthetic peptide of the bioregulator class, studied in research for tissue-specific regulatory activity in respiratory-tissue models.

records.title: Ovagen
records.shortDescription:
Peptide Bioregulator
Ovagen is a short synthetic peptide of the bioregulator class, studied in research within the framework of tissue-specific short-peptide regulators.

records.title: Pinealon
records.shortDescription:
Peptide Bioregulator
Pinealon is a short synthetic tripeptide (Glu-Asp-Arg) of the bioregulator class, studied in research for neuroprotective signaling.

records.title: Sermorelin
records.shortDescription:
GHRH(1-29) Analogue
Sermorelin is a synthetic peptide corresponding to the first 29 amino acids of growth-hormone-releasing hormone, studied in research on the GH/IGF-1 axis.

records.title: VIP
records.shortDescription:
Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide
VIP is a 28–amino acid neuropeptide studied in research for vasodilatory, neuroendocrine, and immunomodulatory signaling.

itemListElement.name: Cartalax
itemListElement.description:
Cartilage-Derived Peptide Research Compound
Cartalax is a synthetic peptide complex derived from cartilage-associated protein fractions and is developed for controlled laboratory research involving connective tissue signaling systems.

itemListElement.name: Epitalon
itemListElement.description:
Synthetic Tetrapeptide Research Compound
Epitalon, also known in scientific literature as Epithalon, is a synthetic tetrapeptide composed of alanine–glutamic acid–aspartic acid–glycine (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly). It is developed for controlled laboratory research involving peptide-mediated regulatory systems.

itemListElement.name: N-Acetyl Epitalon
itemListElement.description:
Acetylated Epitalon Analogue
N-Acetyl Epitalon is the N-terminally acetylated form of the pineal tetrapeptide Epitalon (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly), studied in research on telomere biology and cellular ageing.

itemListElement.name: Vilon
itemListElement.description:
Peptide Bioregulator
Vilon is the dipeptide Lys-Glu, one of the most extensively studied short peptide bioregulators, examined in research on chromatin activation and immune endpoints.

itemListElement.name: Vesugen
itemListElement.description:
Peptide Bioregulator
Vesugen is the tripeptide Lys-Glu-Asp, studied in research on vascular endothelium and age-related vascular change.

itemListElement.name: Vesilute
itemListElement.description:
Peptide Bioregulator
Vesilute is a short synthetic peptide of the bioregulator class, supplied for laboratory research and associated with urinary-tract tissue models.

itemListElement.name: Thymogen
itemListElement.description:
Immunomodulatory Dipeptide
Thymogen is the dipeptide L-glutamyl-L-tryptophan, studied in research on immune modulation and, in rodent models, on carcinogenesis endpoints.

itemListElement.name: Testagen
itemListElement.description:
Peptide Bioregulator
Testagen is the tetrapeptide Lys-Glu-Asp-Gly, studied in research on endocrine tissue models, frequently alongside the related peptide Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly.

itemListElement.name: Prostamax
itemListElement.description:
Peptide Bioregulator
Prostamax is a short synthetic peptide of the bioregulator class, supplied as the tetrapeptide Lys-Glu-Asp-Pro and associated in research with prostate tissue models.

itemListElement.name: Pancragen
itemListElement.description:

itemListElement.name: Livagen
